name: Last Click
languages: Common plus the languages it knew in life

Traits.name: Fear Aura
Traits.text: The last click emanates an aura in a 20-foot Emanation while it doesn't have the Incapacitated condition. *Wisdom Saving Throw*: DC 14, any enemy that starts its turn in the aura. *Failure:* The target has the Frightened condition until the start of its next turn. *Success:* The target is immune to this creature's aura for 24 hours.
Traits.gmQuote: the sound of a door closing in an empty house
Traits.expresses: the report of a door slamming shut in an empty room

Traits.name: Incorporeal Movement
Traits.text: The last click can move through other creatures and objects as if they were Difficult Terrain. It takes 5 (1d10) Force damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

Traits.name: Sunlight Sensitivity
Traits.text: While in sunlight, the last click has Disadvantage on ability checks and attack rolls.

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The last click makes two Slap attacks.

Actions.name: Slap
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 13 (2d8 + 4) Bludgeoning damage plus 7 (2d6) Thunder damage.

Actions.name: Thunderclap (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: *Constitution Saving Throw*: DC 14, each creature in a 20-foot Emanation originating from the last click. *Failure:* 35 (10d6) Thunder damage, and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.gmQuote: the sound of a door closing in an empty house
Actions.minorClause: , and the target has the Deafened condition until the end of its next turn

lore: Born from the final, unremarked click of a door in a house where no one remained to hear it, the Last Click replays that soft shut forever, drifting through empty rooms in search of the listener it was never given.

immunities: Poison; Charmed, Exhaustion, Grappled, Paralyzed, Petrified, Poisoned, Prone, Restrained
